choices.data_reusable: all of it, as sealed evidence and for protocol development
choices.name: KEEP_FROZEN_V2_GATE7_AND_REJECT_CURRENT_DATA_FOR_TRAINING
choices.publication: strongest integrity story; but H1 Recoverability has no trained model, so the primary contribution is lost
choices.risk: the paper's central claim cannot be evaluated at all
choices.scientific_rationale: the gate was frozen 14 days before the data existed, the measurement is a full census with zero defects, and the frozen rule says a failed gate blocks training. Honouring it is the maximally defensible position.
choices.what_changes: nothing scientific; Recoverability V2 training is abandoned under this protocol
choices.what_stays_frozen: everything -- gate 7, Target V4, the acquisition protocol, both seals

choices.label: SCIENTIFICALLY WEAKER
choices.name: POSTHOC_AMEND_GATE7
choices.publication: must be reported transparently as a post-hoc amendment with the original failing value stated; it weakens every prospective-qualification claim, not only gate 7's
choices.risk: reviewers can see the amended threshold sits just above the observed failure
choices.scientific_rationale: the observed exceedance is six aggregates out of 530 and is statistically compatible with an underlying 0.10 (one-sided exact p = 0.2108). An owner may judge the frozen 0.10 to have been mis-specified.
choices.what_changes: the gate-7 threshold, chosen after seeing the failure

choices.compute: high -- a full regeneration of candidate execution, plus more replicas if the new target needs them
choices.data_reusable: source episodes, Stage-A snapshots and graph inputs are reusable; aggregate labels and labelled rows are not; the existing three replicas are a usable prefix only under explicit prospective authorization
choices.fresh_validation_reason: V2 VALIDATION outcomes informed this diagnosis, so they are development evidence and cannot serve as untouched confirmation for a protocol they helped shape
choices.must_be_regenerated: candidate rollouts and all labelled rows
choices.name: PROSPECTIVE_V3_STOCHASTIC_RECOVERABILITY_REPAIR
choices.publication: cleanest prospective story: a predeclared gate caught a real property of the data, the cause was diagnosed, and a better-specified successor was frozen in advance and confirmed on fresh identities
choices.risk: highest compute cost and schedule impact; the H1 statement and its 0.08 threshold may need re-examination rather than silent reuse
choices.scientific_rationale: the forensics show genuine two-sided stochastic boundary behaviour with valid labels and no defect. A successor target that represents that behaviour explicitly -- robust binary with an abstain class, or a calibrated probability -- addresses the cause rather than the symptom.
choices.what_changes: Target semantics, the rollout/aggregation contract, row identity, dataset namespace and seals; a successor stability gate defined on the new target
choices.what_stays_frozen: the source-acquisition protocol V2, the source episode budget, the split policy, the scenario families and layouts

choices.name: OTHER_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED_REPAIR
choices.scientific_rationale: reserved. This phase found no repository evidence for a materially better option than 1, 2 or 3.

constraints_binding_every_choice: the historical V2 gate-7 verdict is FAIL and cannot be retroactively changed by any of these choices
no choice may be justified by the fact that it makes the existing dataset pass
final-test layouts and outcomes remain sealed and must not inform any successor design
